headline: Visitor-attention safety now has release authority, every verified audit item is closed, and production remains safely held by the existing identity gate.

items.title: Attention safety became a release gate
items.insight: Five new and returning visitor histories must pass in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit before the canonical ceremony can succeed.

items.title: Visitors reach real product destinations
items.insight: Solara routes and three canonical product calls to action are repaired, while runtime-aware classification makes the zero-finding court trustworthy.

items.title: Telemetry truth follows bounded helper flow
items.insight: The analyzer recognizes a real helper-forwarded subscription event and exposed two genuinely missing allowlist entries without widening into general code execution.

items.title: Final candidate evidence is coherent
items.insight: Rendered, mobile, link, telemetry, staging, and release evidence all bind the final candidate while the production identity hold remains intact.

followUps: Measure aggregate attention pressure without identifiers or browsing histories.
After the remaining sign-in verification is complete, promote the exact candidate and require the same 15 visitor cases on production.
